dct_description_sm: This is spatial data from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population for the Regional Municipality of Durham, originally published by Statistics Canada.This spatial data is the Toronto Economic Region (ER) geography, of which Durham Region is a part. The column "ERUID" can be used to link to other census tables that aggregate or enumerate at the level of the Economic Region.
dct_title_s: 2021 Census - Durham Region Economic Regions Boundary
schema_provider_s: City of Pickering Open Data Portal
